label: Scoring algorithm (bm25 | tf-idf)
type: the two-member value set of search:scoring-model - bm25 (new in 8.0) or tf-idf (the prior default).
evidence: As of Couchbase Server version 8.0, you can choose to use the bm25 algorithm instead of tf-idf for your Search index.
relates_to_competency_question: What are the two relevance-scoring algorithms a Search index can use, and which one is new?
